detect_windows_platform: check if the current system is a Windows platform using the is_windows function
parse_linux_os_release: parse /etc/os-release to get the Linux distribution name and version using get_linux_type
detect_host_type: create a HostType instance to auto-detect the current OS type, distro, and version
get_package_manager: get the package manager type for a HostType instance such as rpm or deb
parse_host_tuple_string: parse a host type tuple string like linux-fedora-35 into a HostType object using from_tuple_string
